pairs.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/qwen-image-runner.ts:174 This context is server-side generation that downloads provider bytes and writes them to disk, so it has no frame and no render submission. A search of src/lib/visual-gen, src/stores, src/app/api/visual-gen and src/app/api/leonardo found no requestAnimationFrame, drawImage, getContext, WebGLRenderer or frustum.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/qwen-image-runner.ts:174 Generated images are saved as files and never become resident textures here. Image size gating (sharp in seam-check, input-gate) is a quality gate, not a texture residency budget.

pairs.subject: render-submission-economy
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-viewer/SceneViewer.tsx:131 On unmount the viewer disposes only the solid and wireframe materials it created. When the URL changes, the useMemo at line 75 builds a new group and the previous glTF's geometries and textures are never disposed, so GPU residency grows by one model for every model viewed in a session, with no total or growth bound.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-viewer/SceneViewer.tsx:131 Even under the technique's large-memory clause, which asks only for 'a total and a growth check', growth is unbounded. Step 7 ('loading the next one disposing the previous') is not done for the loaded glTF, and there is no header or size check before GLTFLoader decodes. The sibling MaterialPreview does dispose on supersede.

src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-viewer/SceneViewer.tsx:216 A single model, auto-fit to the camera, is always on stage, so there is nothing to cull (the technique's 'everything always visible' exclusion).

src/components/modules/visual-gen/asset-viewer/assetStats.ts:29 The draw-call figure is an asset-inspection proxy for UE, honestly labelled as ungraded, not a frame budget being ordered. No frame-miss remedy is in play.

pairs.registryProposal: The golden path frames residency for games on small devices. A desktop authoring-tool preview that leaks GPU resources for every model viewed is covered only by the 'when not to use' sentence ('a total and a growth check suffice'). Stating that reduced form as an explicit decision rule for tool and preview renderers would make verdicts like this one less of a judgment call.
